consequence.statement: Kubernetes 1.32 is now supported; the evidence states no operational consequence for operators.

original.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 adds support for Kubernetes 1.32.

decision.reason: [ev-6cf643c18c52] lists this only as an added feature, "Support kube 1.32", under Changelog › Features. It says nothing fails, is rejected, stops working or needs migrating, and it does not say that older Kubernetes versions lose support. Adding support for a new version is additive, so "none" (informational) is the best-supported kind. Confidence is low because the one-line changelog entry does not state the operator impact directly.
